assertion: Direction sets paragraph alignment, mixed-script ordering, flex order and logical box sides. CSS embedding, overrides, isolates and plaintext preserve source indices and scope boundaries.

browser.reason: All three browsers agree on text ordering, per-paragraph plaintext alignment and RTL box geometry. Reviewed native and difference images: those semantics match; 7883 changed pixels (maximum 177) are glyph contours/subpixel rasterization and the rounded border edge. Numerical tests separately cover bidi clusters, original UTF-8 offsets, newlines, logical-side cascade, flex order, vertical alignment and backward seeks.
